title: Linked list: insert a node
text: Write a Java method that inserts a new node with value v directly after a given node in a singly linked list. Then explain, in two or three sentences, what happens to the nodes that were already in the list.

title: Collections: remove negative numbers
text: Write a Java method that removes all negative numbers from a List<Integer>. Explain how your loop avoids skipping elements or failing.

title: Searching: binary search
text: Implement binary search on a sorted int array in Java. It returns the index of the key, or -1. Explain why your loop always terminates.
